d:
Watch the official video song for 'Kiya Kiya' from the biggest blockbuster 'Welcome' starring Akshay Kumar, Katrina Kaif, Mallika Sherawat, Paresh Rawal, Nana Patekar & Anil Kapoor.
Relive the magic of Bollywood's golden era with the iconic hit 'Kiya Kiya' from the blockbuster comedy entertainer Welcome! With its infectious melody, energetic beats, vibrant visuals, and timeless Bollywood song, 'Kiya Kiya' continues to win hearts across generations.
Credits
Singer - Anand Raj Anand & Shweta Pandit
Composers - Anand Raj Anand
Lyricist - Anjaan Sagari
Music On - Junglee Music
